verdict.rationale: Vast.ai's REST API is documented as 'the foundation that the CLI and SDK are built on,' with a verified OpenAPI spec, and both CLI and Python SDK explicitly state 'Same operations, different syntax,' covering search, instance lifecycle, templates, volumes, and serverless endpoints. Scoped API keys further support automation/CI use cases matching UI capabilities. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that every UI feature has full API parity (no gaps documented), and no third-party audit confirming completeness of API surface versus UI.
